newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pacific Industrial shares higher in morning.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Industrial shares higher in morning.

text.p: Pacific Industrial Co Ltd shares were higher in active trading on Friday morning, with the Tokyo bourse saying it would announce the outstanding volume of margin trades in the issue, brokers said.
The Tokyo Stock Exchange sometimes announces the outstanding volume of volatile shares as a precautionary measure for investors.
As of 0150 GMT, the shares of the tire, valve and core manufacturer were up 12 yen at 757, with trade totalling 2.75 million shares.
